email_only.title: EP342 - The End of the Attention Economy, and What Retail Does Next with Mitch Joel
email_only.summary: Recorded live from NRF Nexus in Colorado Springs, Jason and Scot sit down with keynote speaker Mitch Joel. His core thesis is that the attention economy is over and we're entering the intimacy economy, where the winning brands make every customer feel like the experience was built just for them.
